notes.title: Update Information 1.0.3 (2017/03/31)
notes.notes:
■Update Details

The following improvement was made:

The setting "Region locking when searching for a multiplayer room" was added to the launcher.
When searching for a multiplayer room, you can set whether to restrict the search to your download region.
Setting this to "OFF" enables you to be matched with users throughout the world; however, depending on your communication environment, you might experience issues such as lagging.

notes.title: Update Information 1.0.2 (2017/03/28)
notes.notes:
■ Update Details

The following issues have been handled:

You can now set whether to enable voice chat from the launcher menu.

Fixed an issue in which the game would sometimes stop during online play.
